title: nixos/sshd: remove 'banner' option, in favour of settings.Banner
reason: Applicable, the coordinator's own flagged case (#35). Real sshd module + wired test. Real diff removes `banner` (mkRemovedOptionModule), replaced by settings.Banner -- another real option-lifecycle event on the same module as S5-A's own moduliFile case.
targets_toml: single target sshd, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,openssh], watch=[banner].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: THIRD REAL ACTIONABLE PRESENTATION (after prosody checkConfig, guacamole logbackXml). check-base exits 1, finding=1, verdict OBA001 'uncovered option branch: no test assignment provably flips this predicate away from its default' on the real `if cfg.banner == null then ... else ...` predicate (line 889) -- both predicate_attempts witnessed=False, real and mechanically consistent with the other two OBA001 instances. At head, banner genuinely removed -> OptionNotFound. This is a DIFFERENT verdict-transition shape than S5-A's own moduliFile case (there, moduliFile was PredicateNotFound at base since it had NO real predicate; here banner DOES have a real predicate that's real but untested).
